name: One bookmark in multiple folders
statement: Users may intentionally place one logical bookmark in multiple folders while retaining a single canonical identity.
requiredProperties: Independent optional title/tags/notes and contextual notes on membership edges
Add vs move vs remove from folder vs delete everywhere are distinct actions
Cross-folder edits remain consistent without duplicating bookmark identity
Duplicate URL does not automatically merge intentional distinct bookmarks
Browser import/export explicitly handles provider limitations and preserves provenance

provenance.sourceReference: Owner Atlas Projects and multi-folder bookmarks requests, 2026-10-15
